content:
mia (AE): NovaLine wants artifacts before POC kickoff: SOC 2 attestation (they specifically asked for an "operational control matrix" summary), ISO27001 cert copy, a signed pen-test attestation letter that includes a redacted CVE summary, and sanitized network diagrams. They also asked whether we can support KMS key custody options (customer-managed) during POC and whether Dedicated is required for EU-only residency. Can someone own artifact pack + presigned upload?

 tom (SE): I can pull the tech bundle and a 6-week POC price delta for Dedicated vs Hosted. Quick notes: we only share full SOC2 reports after NDA; we can produce an operational control matrix PDF that maps controls to our ops runbook for initial review. For KMS: we support customer-managed keys for Private deployments, Dedicated requires additional setup and a non-recurring infra onboarding fee.

 anya (Security): Pen-test reports: we provide a signed attestation letter (scope, test date, 3rd-party tester) and a redacted CVE summary on request. Full vuln artifacts require legal + redaction. Network diagrams must follow our redaction rules (no internal hostnames/IPs, mask customer IDs). If NovaLine insists Dedicated is in-scope for pen-test, that adds ~2 weeks and requires infra coordination. Signatory must be an authorized Security lead — legal will sign off.

 vault-bot: Secure dataroom created: DR-9938. Presigned uploads enabled. Access: mia, tom, anya.

 tom (SE): For their upload preference we can give a presigned POST form (24h expiry) instead of PUT — easier for multi-part uploads. Example doc I send customers:

 curl -X POST "<PRESIGNED_URL>" -F "key=uploads/novaline/%{filename}" -F "Policy=<POLICY>" -F "x-amz-signature=<SIG>" -F "file=@diagram.png"

 I'll create DR-9938, drop a short upload-howto, the operational control matrix, ISO cert, and draft pen-test attestation (unsigned) inside. ETA: 6 hours.

 mia (AE): I'll confirm NovaLine's CISO name/title for NDA and pen-test acceptance and whether they require customer-managed KMS for the POC. Will update when I hear back.

 anya (Security): One more: if they request CVE-level detail we need to run the redaction checklist; please flag early so legal can triage.

 mia (AE): Thanks — keeping this on a tight loop since procurement asked to start next week. :hourglass:
